text:
tess: Quick heads-up  Pacifica RFI needs our final packet. I uploaded capability_table.csv, network_diagram.png, and a draft rfi_responses.docx to /deals/pacifica/rfi. Buyer asks: explicit POC throughput numbers, on-prem HSM options, private peering diagrams, and three pricing bands + single-month dedicated POC fee. Can security/ops/finance sanity-check wording by EOD Thursday?

omar: I'll handle the HSM/KMS wording. Short FAQ copy we should reuse: Private = customer-provided HSM (PKCS#11) + optional private control plane; Dedicated = cloud-KMS/CMEK support with customer key ownership; Hosted = cloud KMS only, we don't hold raw key material. Will add note re: attestation and FIPS requirements.

eli: Ops note: POC throughput depends on model family, avg tokens, and batch/concurrency. Suggested conservative numbers to include: `13B family (4xA100): ~360 req/s (16 tok avg)`; `70B family (8xA100 equiv): ~95 req/s`. I'll paste a tiny CSV and a short assumptions line.

frank: Finance: buyer wants bands at 20k / 200k / 2M tokens/mo and a dedicated POC month flat fee. I'll compute hosted vs dedicated delta and post numbers by Wednesday afternoon. Also they asked about cancellation terms for the POC and egress liability cap.

sales-bot: Reminder: Pacifica RFI due 2025-05-10 17:00 UTC. Upload final artifacts to /deals/pacifica/rfi/FINAL for versioning.

eli: CSV snippet (paste):

```
model,instance,baseline_reqs_per_s,burst_reqs_per_s,assumptions
px-13b,4xA100,360,640,16 token avg, warmed cache
px-70b,8xA100,95,170,16 token avg, large-context opts
embed-fast,2xA100,1250,1900,embedding-only workload
```

omar: Draft HSM paragraph (paste):

"Private deployments: support customer-provided HSMs via PKCS#11/NSS with an integration guide and recommended attestation checks; customer is responsible for key lifecycle. Dedicated deployments: support cloud KMS/CMEK with customer key ownership. Hosted: integrates with cloud provider KMS only; we do not access or persist raw key material. For customers requiring FIPS-validated HSMs, Private deployment is recommended."

eli: Also adding a short assumptions note in the CSV: "Assumptions: 16-token avg response, warmed KV cache, baseline latency targets; actual throughput may vary by prompt shape."

frank: Two buyer blockers flagged: 1) legal requests a proposed egress liability cap (they want number range), 2) infra asks for a POC->prod handover runbook. Who owns runbook?

eli: Ops will draft the runbook. I'll prepare a 2-page runbook with warmup steps, autoscale toggle commands, and metrics to monitor. Will include `kubectl` and autoscaler snippets.

tess: Good. Also the buyer asked about EU data residency (eu-west-1). We should confirm Dedicated/Private can be region-locked via routing policy but note that the control plane remains hosted in our control plane unless they purchase the private control plane add-on. Add that caveat to RFI.

omar: I'll add a short FedRAMP/control mapping paragraph too and flag any controls we partially meet.

tess: One content ask: mark matrix rows that are "operational caveats" (e.g., quantization accuracy impact, fallback routing to compatible model variant). If Dedicated is saturated we sometimes route to lower-capacity variant which affects SLA—call that out.

frank: Finance will give three bands + dedicated-month: tentatively hosted base X, dedicated +22%, POC-month flat $14k (legal TBD). I'll post final numbers by Wed 4pm.

ell: Action items recap:
- omar: finalize HSM paragraph + FedRAMP mapping (due Wed EOD)
- eli: finalize throughput CSV + draft runbook (due Wed noon)
- frank: pricing bands + proposed egress cap guidance (due Wed 4pm)
- tess: assemble final rfi_responses.docx and run internal sign-off thread (due Thu morning)

eli: :thumbsup: I'll annotate the capability_table.csv with caveats and the fallback line.

omar: pinging compliance for FedRAMP note.

tess: I'll schedule a 25m readthrough Thu 11am. Post blockers here.

sales-bot: Attached files should be under /deals/pacifica/rfi/FINAL to be included in the audit export.
